mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread claiming 2024-production King main thrust bearings are out of spec, sliding onto the main cap and block side groove too easily and risking a spun thrust bearing for lack of interference fit. Still open and unanswered by King; most recent post 3 June 2026.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports in-spec measurements on replacement thrust bearings.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Builder reports King STDX undersize bearings for a BMW engine where the thrust bearings were over 1mm too narrow to fit the block, and says the problem repeated across multiple blocks.
mentions.replyNote: Still 307-redirects to the tollbit.m5board.com mirror instead of returning thread content; redirect not followed.

mentions.title: King Bearings Quality?
mentions.snippet: Mopar forum thread questioning King bearing quality, specifically narrowed bearings. King has already replied officially in the thread and discussion continued without escalating.
mentions.replyNote: Re-confirmed: an official King representative replied on 12 August 2026 explaining the narrowed bearings are intentional for larger fillet radii and offering to review part numbers; thread remains open with discussion continuing to 19 September 2026.
